123988.subject: Botany
123988.text: What are the three parts of a bacterial flagellum?
123988.sol: Bacterial cells may be motile or non-motile. If motile, they have thin filamentous extensions from their cell wall called flagella. Prokaryotic ribosomes are larger than eukaryotic ribosomes
Eukaryotic and prokaryotic ribosomes are the same size
Eukaryotic ribosomes are 80S and prokaryotic ribosomes are 70S
124045.sol: Explanation : The eukaryotic ribosomes are 80S while the prokaryotic ribosomes are 70S . Each ribosome has two subunits, larger and smaller subunits. Here ‘S’ (Svedberg’s Unit) stands for the sedimentation coefficient; it is indirectly a measure of density and size. Both 70S and 80S ribosomes are composed of two subunits.
